gaps.sentence: They moved to ___ coastal town an hour south of the capital.
gaps.explanation: A coastal town — first mention of one of many.
Both 'happiness' and 'money' are general here, so no article for either gap.

gaps.sentence: ___ water in this bottle tastes strange.
gaps.explanation: The of/in-phrase makes the noun definite: the water in this bottle.

gaps.sentence: We reached ___ agreement after hours of negotiation.
gaps.explanation: 'Reach an agreement' — 'agreement' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: It's ___ one-way street, so you can't turn left here.
gaps.explanation: 'One' starts with /w/, a consonant sound, so 'a one-way street'.

gaps.sentence: ___ good news is that sales are up by twenty per cent.
gaps.explanation: 'News' is uncountable but takes 'the' when specified: the good news is… 'Sales' here is general, so no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ young woman at reception speaks five languages.
gaps.explanation: 'The young woman at reception' — defined by the location phrase.

gaps.sentence: ___ curiosity killed the cat, as they say.
gaps.explanation: 'Curiosity' as an abstract quality takes no article, even in the proverb.
